thesis: Limitless 5-min ETH up/down resolve via Chainlink ETH/USD 60s-TWAP; a bot reading the stream in the last 60-120s can near-determine the outcome

feed.name: eth-usd-twap-60s
feed.formula: TWAP = sum(price * duration_per_report) / window_seconds; window anchored to LATEST observation (not clock-aligned); ~60 underlying reports of ~1s each; report schema v2 (observationsTimestamp, price int192)
feed.public_catalog_note: feed absent from api.dataengine.chain.link/api/v1/discovery (181 streams listed, no TWAP) - hidden/partner stream

official_access.auth: HMAC headers (Authorization UUID, X-Authorization-Timestamp ms +-5s, X-Authorization-Signature-SHA256)
official_access.pricing_note: All Data Streams subscriptions are paid; no free account tier (docs.chain.link/data-streams/sign-up)

limitless_resolution.rule: Up if TWAP report with observationsTimestamp == deadline >= TWAP report with observationsTimestamp == open (Price to Beat); equality -> Up
limitless_resolution.offset_observed: offsetSeconds=0 in all checked slots; close of slot N == open of slot N+1 (same boundary report)
limitless_resolution.settlement_source: chainlinkTwapResolution.source = 'polymarket-settlement' for ETH 5-min: Limitless mirrors Polymarket markets (isPolyArbitrage=true, externalProvider=polymarket) and settles from Polymarket's payout (same Chainlink TWAP)
limitless_resolution.trading_cutoff: no new trades after deadline; trading allowed during entire final TWAP window
limitless_resolution.anti_snip_setting: metadata.takerDelayMs=250 (taker execution delay, interpretation - friction for sub-250ms stale-quote sniping)

public_free_reading.limitless_meta: GET /markets/{slug} returns open/close TWAP raw values after each boundary; openPrice (strike) visible at slot open -> free Chainlink-TWAP beacon every 5 min for basis tracking
public_free_reading.oracle_candles: GET /markets/{slug}/oracle-candles?from=&to=&interval=1m -> public Chainlink 1m OHLC (18-dec padded); min interval 1m

binance_proxy.note: Chainlink ETH/USD TWAP = Binance ETHUSDT 60s-average - $3.03 +- $0.27 (n=550 windows, 45.8h, 2026-10-22..24); USDT-vs-USD premium; live basis_hat from previous boundary recomputed every 5 min

public_free_reading.pyth: metadata.pythAddress mirrors chainlink feedId for these markets (symbol Crypto.ETH/USD.TWAP60) - Pyth not actually used for resolution; Pyth Hermes (hermes.pyth.network, free, sub-400ms conf feeds) usable only as leading proxy for instantaneous ETH price, NOT the TWAP

math.formula: TWAP(T)=[(60-x)*A_known + x*A_future]/60; A_future ~ N(p_now, sigma^2*x/3); P(correct)=Phi(|E[TWAP-strike]|/sd(x))

backtest.method: 548 contiguous settled slots 2026-10-22..24; Binance 1s closes as price proxy; partial 60s-window average from 1s data; sigma from trailing 30min of 1s logrets; basis_hat updated from previous 5-min boundary (Limitless metadata strike vs own Binance 60s-average)
backtest.caveats: 1m OHLC/4 approximation rejected (minute bars misaligned for T-90/30/10); naive Binance proxy WITHOUT basis correction = coin-flip calibration (P>=0.9 hit 56%) - live basis tracking is mandatory; residual overconfidence at P>=0.995 (98.4% realized) = basis drift within slot + fat tails

polymarket_side.note: real liquidity lives on mirrored Polymarket 5-min markets (settle same Chainlink TWAP); Bloomberg 2026-03-15: 5-min markets up to $60M/day (BTC); our recon (WS-24/25): obvious cases converge to 0.995 well before deadline => informed bots already present there

tos_legality.exploit_resolution_mechanics_clause: not present; nearest clauses: 'manipulation' (requires intent to influence price/outcome) and 'exploiting technical vulnerabilities' (ToS s.7)
tos_legality.platform_publishes_oracle: oracle-candles endpoint returns Chainlink data publicly - sanctioned use
tos_legality.fees_at_extremes: buy fee 0.40% at $0.999; sell fee dynamic peaks 1.50% near $0.50 - curve punishes mid flipping, not late near-certain buys
tos_legality.ban_precedents: none found on Limitless/Azuro/Overtime/Myriad for passive oracle reading; documented cases are active spot manipulation (Polymarket 5-min BTC, retail -$7.6M/2mo, Polymarket switched to TWAP settlement)
tos_legality.risk: sole-discretion termination + funds seizure clause (ToS s.2/7/14); on-chain payouts not clawable back
tos_legality.arxiv: 2606.31675 'Settlement Manipulation in Prediction Markets' (Dai/Jia/Yu, 2026-06-30): settlement-time spot flow spikes + post-settlement reversals; manipulation ~absent on 15-min contracts; recommends longer horizons

verdict.information_edge: REAL - outcome 95%+ determined for ~1/3 of slots by T-60s (model P>=0.97 hit 100% n=165); ~98% of slots decided at T-10s
verdict.limitless_capacity: DEAD - $8.9k total/3.2d, $45 theoretical EV in final minutes; market is a retail ghost town
verdict.polymarket_niche: PARTIALLY OCCUPIED - obvious windows price 0.995 early; residual edge only in fast/unusual windows and on fee/latency advantages
verdict.recommendation: not a standalone income on Limitless; viable as (a) paper-trading training ground, (b) small add-on leg if/when Limitless 5-min liquidity revives, (c) research base for the Polymarket 5-min TWAP game where liquidity exists
